SELECT 'motivo' AS tipo, i.motivo AS chave, count(*) AS n FROM lead_insights i GROUP BY i.motivo
UNION ALL SELECT 'pergunta', p, count(*) FROM lead_insights i, unnest(i.perguntas) p GROUP BY p
UNION ALL SELECT 'objecao', o, count(*) FROM lead_insights i, unnest(i.objecoes) o GROUP BY o
UNION ALL SELECT 'modelo', coalesce(i.model, 'sem IA'), count(*) FROM lead_insights i GROUP BY i.model
UNION ALL SELECT 'custo_usd_x1000', u.model, round(sum(u.cost_usd) * 1000)::bigint FROM ai_agent_usage u WHERE u.kind = 'insights' GROUP BY u.model
UNION ALL SELECT 'resumo', r.week_start::text || ' enviado=' || r.summary_sent::text, r.analyzed FROM weekly_insight_runs r
UNION ALL SELECT 'total', 'analises', count(*) FROM lead_insights
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC, 2
